title: 只做自然柔和的眉形吗？
title_en: Do you only design soft, natural-looking brows?
description: 不是。乐乐老师个人偏爱温柔、自然、原生态，审美带有东方美学的柔和与含蓄。但私人定制不意味着同一种眉毛；温柔自然、清冷精致或利落英气，都可结合五官、骨相、个人气质与审美需求设计。
description_en: No. Lele personally favours soft, natural brows and the restraint of Eastern aesthetics. Bespoke design does not mean one style for everyone: soft and natural, cool and refined, or clean and strongly defined brows can all be considered in relation to your features, bone structure, character and preferences.

title: 到店设计收费吗？
description: 到店设计免费，约30–45分钟。先讨论五官特点、骨相基础、个人气质和审美需求，把眉形画出来给你看，觉得合适再决定做不做，不做也不收费。
description_en: Yes. The design consultation is free and usually takes 30–45 minutes. Discuss your facial features, bone structure, personal character and aesthetic preferences, see the proposed shape, then decide whether to proceed. There is no charge if you decide not to.

title: 项目价格和补色怎么确认？
title_en: Where can I check prices and touch-up terms?
description: 项目价格以大众点评当期门店信息为准。操作前讲清项目、费用与护理安排，收费透明、无隐形消费。所有项目1年内免费补色。
description_en: Check the studio’s current Dianping listing for prices. The service, fees and aftercare arrangements are explained before treatment, with transparent pricing and no hidden charges. All services include free touch-ups within one year.

title: 恢复期和留色时间能保证吗？
title_en: Can recovery time or pigment retention be guaranteed?
description: 不能。恢复表现和留色时间受个人肤质、原有底色、操作及护理等因素影响。门店提供的时间是经验参考，具体以本人恢复情况和到店评估为准。
description_en: No. Skin, existing pigment, the procedure and aftercare can affect healing and retention. Any time estimate is an experience-based guide, not a guaranteed result.

title: 旧眉可以直接重新做吗？
title_en: Can existing brow pigment be worked over?
description: 先看旧底色的深浅、范围和原眉形。底色较深时可能需要先到具备相应资质的机构咨询去色；本店不提供旧色去除服务。
description_en: The depth, extent and shape of existing pigment must be assessed first. Darker residual pigment may need advice on removal from an appropriately qualified provider. This studio does not offer pigment removal.

title: 如何预约到店？
title_en: How do I arrange a visit?
description: 添加微信MiaoMeiHuaMu或致电19282182068，沟通项目与方便到店的时间。乐乐老师本人一对一设计操作，具体时间以回复确认为准。
description_en: Contact the studio on WeChat at MiaoMeiHuaMu or call +86 192 8218 2068 to discuss the service and a suitable time. Lele designs and performs the work personally, one client at a time. An appointment is confirmed by the studio’s reply.
